definitions.valid: canonical flp_target_valid on frozen Phase 9 outer TEST cell IDs
definitions.tv: 0.5 times the sum of six absolute predicted-minus-reference FLP differences
definitions.disagreement: sum of six population between-member FLP variances exported by Phase 9
definitions.baseline: mean six-class target distribution among FLP-valid, train_eligible_fold_i cells
definitions.entropy: negative sum of p log p over the six ensemble-mean FLP probabilities
definitions.high_error: largest round(0.10*n) TV errors within study
definitions.rejection: largest round(fraction*n) ranking scores within study at 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%
definitions.ties: exact ties broken by ascending cell_id; exact counts via Python round
definitions.random: uniform random rejection expectation: unchanged remaining mean TV and recall equal to rejected fraction
